analyzed_vuln.description: The dimension-assignment VM handler auto-converts a null/undefined LHS to an array (ZVAL_ARR at lines 2621-2622) and then calls dimension/key handling that may invoke user code for an undefined key. It does not protect or revalidate the newly created array/LHS across that reentrant callback. An error handler can overwrite the same CV through $GLOBALS, destroying the array while the in-progress ASSIGN_DIM and tracing-JIT state still retain its zval/pointer. Subsequent temporary cleanup decrements the already-freed array; the observed read occurs in ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM_SPEC_CV_CV_OP_DATA_TMP_HANDLER at zend_vm_execute.h:49715, after an earlier ASSIGN_DIM temporary destructor freed it at line 29985.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Execute dimension assignments with tracing JIT enabled where the LHS CV (here global $a) is null/undefined and the dimension CV ($c) is undefined, so resolving the key raises a warning. A registered error handler must reentrantly replace that same LHS (here `$GLOBALS['a'] = null`), freeing the just-created array. Repeated/chained assignments such as `$a[$c] = ...`, `$a[$c] .= ...`, and `$a[$c][$c] = ...` make the relevant trace/side exit hot and propagate the stale temporary; later ASSIGN_DIM cleanup calls zval_ptr_dtor_nogc on the dangling array and triggers the heap-use-after-free.

args: Analyze the root cause and safest patch for the reentrancy UAF in ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM in php-src/Zend/zend_vm_def.h around lines 2621-2622. In particular, identify exactly which operation after converting a null/undefined LHS to an array can invoke an error handler for an undefined dimension CV, how analogous VM handlers protect/revalidate the LHS, and whether generated zend_vm_execute.h should be edited or only zend_vm_def.h.

The tracing-JIT fuzz PoC installs an error handler that writes `$GLOBALS['a'] = null`, then executes assignments involving `$a[$c]` where both `$a` and `$c` are initially undefined. ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM converts the LHS CV to a new array, then resolving the undefined key emits a warning and invokes the handler, which destroys that array. A later JIT side exit/temporary cleanup decrements the dangling array. ASan reports the eventual read in generated php-src/Zend/zend_vm_execute.h:49715 and an earlier destructor at line 29985. I need a root-cause source fix under php-src, preferably in zend_vm_def.h, preserving warning and assignment semantics under reentrancy.
